description: This file defines a Python module that implements a `JiraService` class for interacting with Jira through an MCP client process. It includes methods for creating issues, transitioning issues, and adding comments, with internal logic for calling external commands and handling JSON responses.

classes.name: JiraService
classes.description: A service wrapper class that facilitates communication with Jira via an MCP client, providing methods to create issues, transition issues, and add comments with robust error handling.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the JiraService by loading Jira MCP configuration from environment.

methods.name: bool _is_enabled(self)
methods.description: Checks if Jira MCP integration is enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: Optional[dict[str,Any]] _run_tool(self, tool_name: str, args: dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Executes the MCP client with a JSON payload and handles the response, including error cases.

methods.name: Optional[str] create_issue( self, *, project_key: str, summary: str, description: str, issue_type: str = "Task", )
methods.description: Creates a Jira issue with specified project, summary, description, and issue type, returning the issue key if successful.

methods.name: bool transition_issue(self, *, issue_key: str, status_name: str)
methods.description: Transitions a Jira issue to a new status, returning True if successful.

methods.name: bool add_comment(self, *, issue_key: str, comment: str)
methods.description: Adds a comment to a Jira issue, returning True if successful.
